title: Reconstructions of Single Pixel X-Ray Transforms with Applications in Nuclear-Disarmament Verification
summary: In nuclear arms control and disarmament processes, it is crucial to determine whether an object is a nuclear weapon or not without revealing sensitive information about it. At the MIT: Laboratory for Nuclear Security and Policy, such a nuclear verification method was developed, showcasing a transmission-based approach [1]. This method's essential part rests on a mathematical operation, the Single-Pixel X-Ray Transform: a cone of X-rays transmits an object and the remaining intensity is measured with a single-pixel detector.
